title: CODE-SHARP: Continuous Open-ended Discovery and Evolution of Skills as Hierarchical Reward Programs
abstract: arXiv:2602.10085v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A core quality of general intelligence is the ability to open-endedly expand and evolve its set of mastered skills autonomously. While recent Foundation Model (FM) driven approaches have shown promising results towards this goal, they typically rely on significant human-in-the-loop engineering, limiting their transferability to novel environments. To address this, we introduce Continuous Open-ended Discovery and Evolution of Skills as Hierarchical Reward Programs (CODE-SHARP), a framework that leverages FMs to open-endedly grow and evolve an archive of Python programs encoding skills to train a generalist agent policy entirely from scratch via reinforcement learning, directly from source code. These programs, termed Skills as Hierarchical Reward Programs (SHARPs), each encode a local success condition and a set of prerequisites delegated to previously discovered SHARPs. translated_title: CODE-SHARP：以分层奖励程序形式实现技能的持续开放式发现与演化
translated_abstract: 通用智能的一个核心特质是能够自主地、开放式地扩展和演化其所掌握的技能集合。尽管近期由基础模型驱动的相关方法在实现这一目标方面展现出令人鼓舞的结果，但它们通常依赖于大量的人在环工程介入，限制了其向新环境迁移的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CODE-SHARP（以分层奖励程序形式实现技能的持续开放式发现与演化），这是一个利用基础模型开放式地增长和演化一个由Python程序构成的技能库的框架，这些程序对技能进行编码，并通过强化学习直接从源代码出发，完全从零开始训练一个通用智能体策略。这些程序被称为分层奖励程序形式的技能，每个程序编码一个局部成功条件以及一组委托给先前已发现的SHARP的前提条件。在运行时，SHARP会动态地将智能体引导至其预先……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CODE-SHARP框架，利用基础模型开放式地发现和演化编码为分层奖励程序（SHARP）的Python技能库，直接从源代码通过强化学习完全从零开始训练通用智能体策略，减少了对人在环工程的依赖。
en_tdlr: CODE-SHARP leverages Foundation Models to open-endedly discover and evolve an archive of Python skills encoded as hierarchical reward programs (SHARPs), training a generalist agent policy entirely from scratch via reinforcement learning directly from source code, thereby reducing reliance on human-in-the-loop engineering.
